title: Payment and duplicate-charge policy
content: Payment failures and duplicate-charge reports are reviewed by Payments Support. The system must not promise a reversal or refund until payment records are verified.

title: Unauthorized payment policy
content: Potentially unauthorized payments are security-sensitive. The ticket is escalated to a human agent for secure investigation; automated responses must not ask for full payment credentials.

title: Delayed delivery and tracking policy
content: For delayed or untracked orders, Logistics Support checks the order and shipment records. The system must not invent a delivery date or claim that an order has shipped.

title: Missing delivery policy
content: If an order is marked delivered but is missing, a specialist verifies delivery evidence and the order details before deciding the next step.

title: Refund request policy
content: Refund eligibility is checked against the approved returns policy and order records. The system must not claim that a refund has been approved.

title: Refund status policy
content: For a pending refund, Returns and Refunds verifies the refund reference and payment records before providing a status update.

title: Account access policy
content: For password recovery, registration, or account-lockout issues, Account Support uses the approved recovery process. Never request passwords or one-time verification codes in a support message.

title: Technical troubleshooting policy
content: For application, website, checkout, or product technical issues, Technical Support gathers safe diagnostic details and verifies the issue before proposing a resolution.

title: Human agent policy
content: Customers may request a human support agent at any time. Explicit human-agent requests are routed to the Human Escalation Queue.
